peg.peg_mechanism_score_basis: MEASURES THE MECHANISM, NOT THE CURRENT DEVIATION. This scores how the peg is defended — PegKeeper arbitrage, the soft-liquidation AMM and the redemption path — not whether crvUSD is at par today. PERSISTENCE-FILTERED: it does not move on a spot reading. A live band showing par tells a reader the mechanism is working right now; this asks whether it holds under stress it has not yet met.

backing.backing_score_basis: MEASURES RESERVE COMPOSITION AND ITS CONCENTRATION, not the live collateral ratio. ⚠️ EXPLICIT PERSISTENCE RULE: cut below 5.0 only if total_pegkeeper_debt / total_supply holds above 25% for MORE THAN 5 CONSECUTIVE DAILY READINGS. A four-day excursion with the peg at par is the mechanism working, not a deterioration. The rule has been applied against itself: a 2026-08-24 cut to 4.5 was REVERSED on 2026-09-07 because it had been made at the peak of a four-day transient that would not have fired the rule. Current reading 6.8%, well under the line.
backing.backing_score_persistence: filtered — 25% threshold over >5 consecutive daily readings

liquidity.liquidity_score_basis: MEASURES THE DOLLAR EXIT SPECIFICALLY, which is why it sits below a live depth band. ⚠️ NOT ONE YieldBasis cryptopool pairs crvUSD with a dollar — all eight are WBTC, cbBTC, tBTC or WETH — so selling into them leaves a holder in BTC or ETH. One-hop dollar exit is $27.68M, 11.91% of issuance-side supply; the two-hop BTC/ETH route is $144.8M and is a REAL exit, just not a dollar one. A live band aggregating both answers a different question from the one a seller asks. PERSISTENCE-FILTERED: prices the standing venue structure, not a daily depth quote. ⚠️ UPDATED 2026-09-10: the exit ladder was repaired at source (12 failed rungs estate-wide to zero), and crvUSD's 2% depth is now BRACKETED rather than a floor — the crossing sits between $5M (2.2% of supply) and $50M (21.5%), a 10x range that the rung-selection algorithm will not narrow because it maximises distance from chosen rungs and never looks INSIDE a bracket. The published $5M is the last rung that cleared, so true depth is HIGHER. This score does not rest on that figure — it rests on the dollar-versus-BTC/ETH exit split, which is measured from pool balances.
liquidity.liquidity_score_persistence: filtered — venue structure, not spot depth
liquidity.liquidity_score_depth_caveat: 2% crossing is BRACKETED $5M-$50M, not a point estimate; published $5M is the last cleared rung, so true depth is higher

dependencies.underlying_score_basis: MEASURES COUNTERPARTY CONCENTRATION IN THE SUPPLY ARCHITECTURE — who crvUSD relies on to exist, not whether it is backed. ✅ THE DENOMINATOR IS NOW COMPLETE, enumerated 2026-09-10 rather than assumed: every SetDebtCeiling grant in the ControllerFactory's full history was swept (869 windows, 17,257,955 to head), yielding 31 distinct recipients ever granted a ceiling and 18 with a live one. Live ceilings sum to 2,104,650,000 against a totalSupply of 2,104,809,204.98 — a residual of 0.0076%, which is accrued interest. YieldBasis is 47.51% of that complete set; the top three grantees are 66.52%. Bounded: debt_ceiling equals debt_ceiling_residual, so headroom to mint is ZERO and the fast path reallocates rather than creates. ⚠️ FOUR WINDOWS (0.46% of history) FAILED AND WERE NOT RECOVERED — but the ceiling sum reconciling to supply is itself the completeness proof, since a grant hiding in those blocks would push the total ABOVE totalSupply.
dependencies.underlying_score_persistence: filtered — supply architecture, not a daily balance
dependencies.underlying_score_denominator: complete: 31 grantees enumerated from full SetDebtCeiling history; live ceilings reconcile to totalSupply within 0.0076%

issuer.issuer_score_basis: MEASURES THE ENTITY AND THE CONCENTRATION OF INFLUENCE OVER IT. ✅ Curve is one of DeFi's most established protocols — 10+ audit firms and a $2B+ TVL history, which is a long operating record rather than a reputation. ⚠️ CRV tokenomics add governance complexity: vote-escrow and gauge weighting mean influence is purchasable and concentrated rather than one-address-one-vote. ⚠️⚠️ AND THE BINDING FACT IS A PERSON, NOT A PROCESS: Egorov's DUAL Curve/YieldBasis ROLE creates concentrated influence over crvUSD's SUPPLY ARCHITECTURE specifically — the same party shapes both the issuer and a major consumer of its debt ceilings. ⚠️ THAT IS A DEPENDENCY-ADJACENT FACT PRICED HERE RATHER THAN ON AXIS 4, because it is about who decides, not about what backs; do not dock it twice.
